title: An Empirical Survey on Long Document Summarization: Datasets, Models and Metrics

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the uniformity metric by calculating the normalized entropy of the decile positions of salient unigrams in the source text to determine if important information is disproportionately concentrated in specific areas (e.g., the beginning of the document).

Conducting ad-hoc experiments on unsupervised graph-based extractive summarization models to evaluate the performance impact of incorporating discourse bias mechanisms (adjusting sentence centrality scores based on intra-section and inter-section boundaries).
